spec.claim_summary: Buying bitcoin when price falls below the 200-week moving average is presented as a buying opportunity.

claimed.other: Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today

assumptions: Asset BTCUSDT interpreted from Bitcoin in the claim.
Timeframe 1d chosen as the page chart timeframe; weekly bars unavailable so 200-week average approximated as 1400-day average on daily bars (200*7, crypto trades 7 days/week).
'moving average' with no type stated interpreted as simple moving average (SMA).
'falls below' and 'drops below this threshold' interpreted as a crosses_below trigger for an automatic buy order, not a continuous below state.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim implies indefinite buy-and-hold with no exit; schema requires an exit so max_hold_bars set to 100000 daily bars to approximate holding to end of available history without forcing a timed sell.

evidence.quote: price falls below its 200-week moving average
Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today
